result.title: VLMs Read Aloud: The Gap Between Recognizing and Using Visual Text
result.summary: Visual-text compression renders long contexts as images and is engineered around how much of the text a vision-language model (VLM) can recover. Yet recovered text is not usable text. VLMs can transcribe the text in an image word for word and still fail to answer from it; given back their own transcript, they answer nearly as well as from the original text. We call this difference the read-use gap. Recognizing and using visual text have different resolution requirements: Qwen3-VL-8B's recognition saturates at 15-pixel characters while use catches up only at 24 pixels, and scaling from 2B to 32B raises recognition without narrowing the gap. Putting the evidence into words closes it: thinking VLMs recite the evidence in their thinking, and their own transcript, written without seeing the question, recovers most of what thinking adds. In a preregistered held-out test, the gap ranks how much eight VLMs gain from their own words over pixels (Spearman $ρ$ = 0.86), which recognition rates do not. We propose ALOUD, which spends visual resolution on finding and recognizing evidence and language tokens on using it. Without keeping the source text, it doubles the accuracy of a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B on long documents compressed 5x and 10x: at 5x, from 27.7% to 54.8%, near the original text's 58.5%, with a context smaller than the compressed pages themselves. For less than the cost of reading the original text, it leads at equal budget every method that does without it, at every level, and beats AGAR and VERA, which paste the original text back; at 5x it also beats LensVLM-9B, which is trained and keeps the original text. Visual-text compression is limited not by how much text a model can recover, but by how much it can use.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「read-use gap」，即 VLM 能逐字识别图像中的文本却无法据此作答；作者用识别与使用所需的分辨率差异、模型规模扩展及 preregistered 的 held-out 测试量化该差距，并据此提出 ALOUD：把视觉分辨率用于定位与识别证据，把语言 token 用于使用证据，在冻结的 Qwen3-VL-8B 上提升长文档压缩场景的准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接针对视觉证据是否真正被内部状态使用（而非仅被编码识别）这一核心问题，涉及信息坍缩、视觉旁路与「把证据转写为语言后即可用」的对比，其结论（瓶颈在使用而非恢复）可能直接影响视觉压缩与 latent 视觉推理的选题假设，值得优先核查。
